actions.title: Order urine albumin/creatinine ratio
actions.why: Catches kidney damage years before creatinine moves.
actions.reasoning: eGFR is 111.81 and creatinine 0.95 mg/dL both optimal, yet urine ACR has never been measured.

followUp.ask: What was the urine ACR result?

actions.title: Order TPO antibodies
actions.why: Says whether a wobbly thyroid is autoimmune.
actions.reasoning: TSH 1.4 mIU/L is optimal yet TPO antibodies have never been measured; family history none known.

followUp.ask: What was the TPO antibody result?

actions.title: Order cystatin C
actions.why: A second, muscle-independent view of kidney function.
actions.reasoning: eGFR 111.81 based on creatinine; grip strength 56 kg and age 28 indicate high muscle mass, so cystatin C provides orthogonal data.

evidence.title: Cystatin C vs creatinine in athletes and high-muscle individuals

followUp.ask: What was the cystatin C result?

questions.text: Has anyone in your family been diagnosed with Hashimoto’s, Graves’, or any other thyroid condition?
